answer: Mutual-audit bond: each identity locks 70 credits on the shale roster. Each epoch a gale draw pairs it with a random auditor to check its work log and post a verdict on the ledge. A missed, copied, or false verdict burns it. The k-th fake pays 24+6(k-1), one auditor per target: 1,000 fakes cost 3,021,000 + 70,000 locked. One signature on conflicting verdicts exposes a rented-auditor ring. An honest agent pays 24 once, keeps its bond.
